messages.author: 5f1cb0ac57baae2b
messages.subject: Renaming the thermal band
parts:
Hello, 

Is there anyway to rename the bands before they are displayed with fieldIndex? I am using an Altum sensor and while the R,G,B,RE,and NIR bands can all be defined, the 6th band is thermal and displays as "xfilename.6". 

While not a huge problem, when I go to write the shapefile the name is too long and I get the warning "Warning message: In writeOGR(RGB.Info$fieldShape, "F:/Turf/Iron Dollar Spot/2021/shapefiles/iron",  : Field names abbreviated for ESRI Shapefile driver". 

I believe this is causing further issues when I import the shapefile for further analysis. It imports fine but when I use the shapefile in fieldInfo the resulting table has the VI's double and I think it may be because the shapefile has names that don't match up and so it repeats.

Thanks, 

Eric

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Renaming the thermal band
parts:
Hi Eric,

Thanks for asking. 

Please, try this code before fieldIndex() and let us know if it worked:

names(mosaic)<-c("Blue","Green","Red","RedEdge","NIR","Thermal")

Feel free to change the layers' names and the sequence. Please check if the Red is the 1st or the 3rd layer in your sensor.

Best,
Filipe
